originality.rationale: Nill large-width hypothesis is inapplicable to bounded-width prism bases; the Liu/Wagner product theorem assumes real-rooted inputs and does not imply the cases with 1+kt+kt^2 for k=1,2,3; the published segment-factor result only proves log-concavity. Precisely these uncovered cases are resolved here. Best-knowledge result, with documented historical-priority uncertainty.

value.rationale: A natural infinite geometric class of all three-dimensional polygonal lattice prisms has real-rooted numerators without any width assumption. The theorem repairs all three possible complex-rooted planar numerators using only a unit segment, an implication beyond standard product real-rootedness preservation and mere log-concavity.
